en: Colorized historical street scene showing people in early 20th‑century clothing walking through a broad urban square lined with ornate multi‑story buildings and shops. On the left is a Gothic-style stone façade with statues and large tracery windows, likely part of a church or town hall. The central view looks down a street bordered by commercial buildings with signs in German. The sky is tinted light blue and orange, giving a hand-colored postcard look. The printed caption at the top reads the city name and indicates a view over Marienplatz and Marienstraße.
